review: GET/PATCH identity is only ctx.actor; all onboarding reads and upserts use branch and username from the resolved DB actor.
The onboarding policy supports read/update only and denies corrupt roles. Context is resolved through token-version verification and a DB actor projection that contains no onboarding progress.
No authz guard, relation or existing access policy reads onboarding progress. Source collection touch points are the state API and successful-password completion write.

Password changes preserve the old-password check, new scrypt hash, branch-stamped read/write, matchedCount guard and tokenVersion increment. The student-only progress write follows the successful update and cannot change its outcome.
The 184-test suite includes mocked route/policy/guard tests; it is not a live database authorization run. No production or Atlas access occurred.
